candidates: astrobiology: a drill at a gas-giant moon's ocean station breaks through to water warmer than any model allows
family law: three parties claim custody of a nine-year-old orphan of a colonist and a non-aligned trader, and the Enterprise is the nearest Federation authority
astrophysics: a recurrent nova is due in a binary whose outer planet holds a poor colony that lost the records of its own shelters
linguistics: a delegation's language marks evidentiality, and the translator has been rendering every hearsay statement in their grievance as eyewitness testimony
economics: a strike at a dilithium refinery that supplies three starbases
epidemiology: a disease jumping from a colony's herds to its people, with the colony's own doctor set on destroying a native species she blames
premises.chosen: epidemiology, made particular: the Ealat herding colony on Hesker IV; an Earth enterovirus brought with the founders' live herds has turned cardiotropic in selenium-deficient animals on the newest pasture, and the colony's doctor blames a native insect

canon_distance.Symbiosis: two sentient species and a plague that is really drug dependency, kept by one side's deception; here one human colony, a real virus, and a misdiagnosis nobody intends; the deception is a speaker protecting a pasture decision
canon_distance.Code of Honor: a vaccine as a MacGuffin held by a foreign culture; here nobody holds the answer: it has to be worked out from soil, records and herders
canon_distance.Home Soil: terraformers unknowingly destroy a native intelligence; here the native species is only an insect and a scapegoat, and the cause is the colonists' own animals and their own decision
canon_distance.Unnatural Selection: an engineered pathogen at a research station; here an ordinary Earth virus changed by a mineral deficiency, the science real and known on Earth since the twentieth century
